terra.problem: Papa describes himself making phone calls to arrange an oven repair. Phones outside his bakery should come up as things people do, not as part of his own world.
Saying asking God was David's first move overlooks that he had already gone out to face the Philistines (verse 8).
The passage says the Philistines abandoned their gods. It does not say they lost track of them or that they trusted them.
The passage does not mention a Philistine king, but that does not establish that no king was left behind.
The text reports David's order, but does not say there was no debate or committee.
The timer comparison blends the everyday image with the Bible setting by putting the timer in the treetops.
God told David to wait for the sound before moving out, so saying He gave him no waiting period is misleading.
The joke about Papa not reading the recipe repeats the recipe-mistake idea from stop 2, card 2, answer 1.
The explanation says the verse credits the LORD with spreading David's fame. It specifically says the LORD caused the nations to fear him.
